costs.freeze_basis: symmetric merge/split prior, risk severity before new outcomes; no dev-HOTA tuning

diagnostics.feature_deletion_claim: inference dependency only, not retrained causal architecture advantage

formal.qualification: P1 complete, label qualifications, pilot finite and action semantics passing; architectures chosen from preregistered fixed/multi/set/shared_mlp order

incomplete_status: NOT_RUN with exact dependency/reason; never invented metrics

independent_validation.scheme_A: inventory server external TRAIN data first; freeze official protocol before outcomes
independent_validation.scheme_B: clean Stage1 only after generic initializer/data/config/budget eligibility; no historic checkpoint reuse as clean

labels.Q1: multi-positive certified natural lawful identity choices
labels.Q2_negative: all lawful histories certifiable and none matches; or explicitly versioned TRAIN-only paired withholding
labels.Q2_positive: at least one past-only certified pure matching lawful identity
labels.Q3: candidate past observed GT support: >=3 known observations, >=0.8 GT coverage; pure=one GT; contaminated=>=2 GT with >=2 observations each
labels.Q3_scope: observed-history purity, never proof of complete biometric purity
labels.UNKNOWN: never a negative or an absent-identity certificate
labels.withholding: remove ALL certified target options for a certified row; if any UNKNOWN options remain, absence remains UNKNOWN; no fake NEW/REACT

pilot.sampling: TRAIN identity/time blocks; source-paired presence/withholding balanced with natural data
pilot.train_audit_split: deterministic video-local 64-frame blocks; frame//64 %5==4 reserved, never gradient training

scientific_gates.G1: artifact-backed event taxonomy and exact CLEAR IDSW reconstruction
scientific_gates.G2: independent Q2/Q3 labeled support and held TRAIN-block learnability, not gradient alone
scientific_gates.G3: withholding only DEFER, never NEW or recovery labels; lifecycle learned heads remain disabled unless genuinely qualified
scientific_gates.G4: HOTA/AssA/IDF1 versus frozen controls; IDSW<=102.5; no increase in certified merges/splits/births relative fixed20k
scientific_gates.G5: same-supervision multi-question beats both fixed and set by>=0.5 HOTA/AssA mean with nonnegative HOTA per seed and stable action risk; exploratory, not statistical significance
scientific_gates.G6: actual native MATLAB CVIDF1/CVMA and cross-camera attribution
scientific_gates.G7: Stage2 p95<=10ms AND full image-to-tracks>=25 sceneFPS, repeat3 same-hardware trials; old G8 remains FAIL
scientific_gates.G8: unseen frontend scene exposure verified; else independent-full-system claim NO_GO
